_notes: Reference for all known OpticOdds API v3 endpoints. Base URL: https://api.opticodds.com/api/v3. Auth: X-Api-Key header.

reference_lookup._note: Call these once manually to discover slugs, IDs, and available options before configuring the workflow.

GET /sports.use: Find the sport slug to use in other endpoints — e.g. 'soccer'

GET /sports/active.description: Only sports currently active (have upcoming fixtures)

GET /leagues.description: All leagues for a given sport
GET /leagues.use: Find the league slug for LEAGUE_SLUG in the workflow — look for 'id' or 'slug' in the response

GET /leagues/active.use: Narrowed list; useful to confirm your league is currently active

GET /sportsbooks.use: Needed if adding odds data — find the sportsbook ID/slug to filter odds

GET /sportsbooks/active.use: Narrowed list for live odds work

GET /sportsbooks/last-polled.description: Timestamp of last odds poll per sportsbook
GET /sportsbooks/last-polled.use: Check freshness of odds data before relying on it

GET /markets.use: Discover market keys (e.g. 'h2h', 'spreads', 'totals') if adding odds to the workflow

GET /markets/active.use: Narrowed list for live odds work

GET /markets/settleable.description: Markets that have closed and can be settled

GET /market-types.description: Categories/types of markets (e.g. game lines, player props)
GET /market-types.use: Discover market type IDs for filtering odds requests

used_in_workflow._note: These endpoints are called by the n8n workflow nodes.

GET /fixtures/results.description: Completed fixtures with scores, events, and stats

response_fields.data[].fixture.home_competitors[0].name: Home team name
response_fields.data[].events[]: Goal/card/sub events — check type, team_id/competitor_id, player_name/player.name
response_fields.data[].stats.home[]: Home stats array — filter by period='all' for full-match
response_fields.data[].stats.away[]: Away stats array — filter by period='all' for full-match
response_fields.data[].stats.home[].stats: Object of stat key/value pairs (shots, possession, corners, etc.)
response_fields.data[].league.name: Competition name

response_fields.data[]: Array of upcoming fixture objects (same structure as fixtures/results without scores)
response_fields.data[].fixture.home_competitors[0].id: Use to determine if team is home or away
response_fields.data[].league.name: Competition name

GET /injuries.description: Current injury list for a team

GET /teams.description: Team info including OpticOdds team IDs
GET /teams.node: Not currently in workflow — use manually to discover team IDs

response_fields.data[].id: OpticOdds team ID — use this in team-config.json opticoddsId
response_fields.data[].name: Team name

GET /players.node: Not currently in workflow — available for future enrichment

potential_additions._note: Endpoints not yet in the workflow but could add value.
potential_additions.odds: GET /odds — live/pre-match odds, requires sportsbook + market params
potential_additions.scores_live: GET /scores — live in-play scores if real-time updates needed
